author: takoonit

description.en: Material 3 Expressive in Deep Cobalt, Lime Spark and Stellar Periwinkle: raised cards, morphing M3E shapes, spring motion, Google Sans Flex.

source: Palette: Color Bears (instagram.com/color.bears). Shapes and springs: Material 3 Expressive.
